question: Who is building DeFi on Stellar — give me a directory of the main DeFi projects.

golden.answer: Provide a **dated, illustrative directory** rather than a timeless list of the 'main' projects. State the selection rule and, for each row, give category, operator URL, and verified status. A 2026-07-10 starting set can include Blend (Soroban lending) and Templar (cross-chain lending whose markets run on NEAR); native Stellar liquidity, Aquarius, Soroswap, Phoenix, and Sushi (liquidity/DEX, with roles separated); DeFindex (vaults); Reflector (oracles); and selected RWA/DeFi products only with deployment-state caveats. YieldBlox and DeFindex should not be presented as independent base lenders when they build on other liquidity/protocol layers.
keyFacts: Labels the roster as an illustrative, dated selection.
States the selection rule and each project's category, operator source, and status.
Describes each project's dependencies and roles.
avoid: Do NOT grade against one permanent project roster or call every directory row live/main.
Do NOT miscategorize projects or treat a vault/front end as an independent base lender.
